sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
Transport for NSW (Transport) is progressing the next phase of bus service contracting reform across its operating regions. Transport is currently developing the next generation of contracts for bus, light rail and ferry services as existing agreements progressively expire from June 2028.

Transport is seeking feedback from industry on the development of these contracts, including opportunities to improve service delivery, contract management, asset maintenance and commercial arrangements. Industry feedback will be important in ensuring that future contracts respond to the Bus Industry Taskforce recommendations and Audit Office Report recommendations, while also aligning with the broader Transport and NSW government outcomes such as Net Zero Plan and Connecting NSW Strategy and create a sustainable contracting regime which delivers improved outcomes for the people of NSW.

As part of the development process, Transport is undertaking industry consultation exercise to gather feedback from industry. This engagement will assist Transport understanding industry perspectives on key operational, commercial and delivery considerations associated with the future contracting framework.

Scope

sections.content:
In order to gain access to the Tender documents, tenderers are required to email tss.bidder@transport.nsw.gov.au and include the following information:

1) Tender Name and Reference Number

2) Organisation Name

3) ACN/ABN

4) Organisation Address

5) Contact Person Name

6) Contact Person Phone Number

7) Contact Email Address

Once your details are received, an invitation from Ariba Sourcing will be sent containing a link to access the tender documents.

When logging into Ariba Sourcing, the following browsers are recommended - Google Chrome 54+ (64-bit); Microsoft Internet Explorer 7-11(32-bit); Mozilla Firefox 24 or 27(ESR); Safari 9+ (64-bit); Microsoft Edge (32-bit)

sections.heading: Additional details/instructions

sections.content:
Mandatory requirements

1. Modern slavery *

Vehicles - Trucks, Trains and Buses

This procurement category has a heightened risk of modern slavery.

You will be asked to provide information about modern slavery risks in your business and any actions you have taken to address these. You can visit the NSW Anti-slavery Commissioner’s GRS webpage for more information.

Do you agree to provide this information?

Response type

Checkbox (Agree)

Opportunity requirements

1.

Capability Statement (Appendix A)

To participate in this industry consultation process:

1. Complete the Capability Statement (Appendix A) to demonstrate that your entity has recent relevant experience in delivering public passenger transport services within a metropolitan or outer metropolitan areas or comparable operating environments.

2. Submit the completed capability statement in Ariba Section 1.2.

3. Transport will review and confirm eligibility of entities.

4. If deemed eligible, your entity will be issued with the access to Appendix B Industry Consultation Questionnaire (excel format).

5. Complete the Questionnaire (Appendix B) and send a copy of your response in the Ariba Message Board at your earliest convenience (prior to 22 Sep 2026).

6. On the due date, you are required to submit the final response of Appendix B Industry Consultation Questionnaire (Even if you have previously submitted the information via the Ariba Message Board) in Ariba Section 2.0.

7. Transport may, at its absolute sole discretion, contact one, or more Participants, where necessary, to seek further clarification on the submitted feedback in greater detail.

Response type

File upload (Multiple)
